mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates a weak labor market and potential economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment that depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low industrial production growth (INDPRO < 95), supply constraints and weak manufacturing activity signal an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) compresses real interest rates and increases uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 220, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 jobs signals a strong labor market and potential inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 220) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a lack of monetary policy response to inflation, increasing stagflation risk and depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95), prolonged supply constraints and weak manufacturing activity lead to S&P 500 underperformance over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
